### About

<div class="about-grid">
<div class="prose">
<p>I consider myself a hybrid professional, with a strong background in ecology and data analysis. I am a passionate educator and thoroughly enjoy chances to teach and learn with audiences of all levels of prior experience. And I like to see the glass as half full: a positive attitude is my key to living in this world. Away from science, I produce Modena balsamic vinegar — you can get more information <a href="https://acetaia-insieme.github.io">here</a>.</p>
